title: Crowned Plasma Orb
description: A glowing red and black humanoid figure stands at the center of a transparent spherical orb, emitting bright blue and orange plasma tendrils. An ornate golden crown with purple gems floats above the orb while colorful energy streams and bubbles swirl outward against a dark background.
prompt: A mysterious dark humanoid figure stands inside a large transparent energy sphere, with intense red glowing core at its chest. Bright blue and orange plasma streams radiate outward from the figure. An ornate golden crown with purple gemstones floats above the sphere. Swirling colorful energy ribbons and floating purple orbs surround the device. The sphere rests on an ornate dark metallic pedestal base engraved with text. Dramatic lighting, vibrant energy effects, dark cosmic background.
